description: This Java class 'ControllerViewArtifactInfo' models information about a controller view in the OFBiz framework, including its URL, view URI, associated screen, and related request info.

classes.name: ControllerViewArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents a controller view in OFBiz, encapsulating its URL, view URI, associated screen, and related request information.

methods.name: ControllerViewArtifactInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with controller XML URL, view URI, and artifact info factory, and sets up associated screen info if applicable.

methods.name: getControllerXmlUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the controller XML file.

methods.name: getViewUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the view.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Generates a display name combining view URI and relative location of controller XML.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for controller view info.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier combining controller XML URL and view URI.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the controller XML file.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on controller XML URL and view URI.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on toString() output.

methods.name: getRequestsThatThisViewIsResponseTo
methods.description: Returns set of request info objects referring to this view.

methods.name: getScreenCalledByThisView
methods.description: Returns the screen widget info called by this view.
